detail.title: 3 in 1 Type C USB HUB
detail.overview: Discover the 3 in 1 Type C USB HUB by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Expand one USB-C port to HDMI 4K output, USB-C PD, and USB3.0 port simultaneously.
Enjoy super-speed data transfer, UHD movies, and power supply for your device all at once.
Supports 4K UHD resolutions up to 3840x2160@30Hz for high-quality video output.
Compatible with most monitors, projectors, HDTVs, and devices with HDMI ports.
Compact and versatile 3-in-1 design for convenient connectivity on the go.
